planets.name: HD 60779 b
planets.description: HD 60779 b crosses its star every 30 days and is 3.2 times as wide as Earth, found in 2026.

text.card: HD 60779 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 60779. Its orbit and size follow DiTomasso et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
